conf.description: FireEye AX ax-alert CEF notification feed: header split + fixed-slot extension decode (cs1=sname, cs4=link, per recommendations.direct.cribl's own explicit slot naming for this appliance) mapping the verdict headline to ECS, keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / ax-alert / syslog-cef. Single-line CEF alternative to the JSON feed (mutually exclusive Format selection on the notification channel). No os-changes trace and only one file hash (MD5) on this transport - the analyst pivot to the full detonation trace is the cs4/link deep link. Unlike the sibling nx-alert CEF pipeline, recommendations.direct.cribl for AX names cs1(sname) and cs4(link) directly rather than warning that slot assignment drifts across trains, so this pipeline uses a fixed-slot mapping instead of the Label-indirection technique used for nx-alert. Keeps _raw alongside the flattened fields, matching the json format's forensic-retention rationale.

functions.description: record approach and the fixed-slot-vs-Label-indirection contrast with the sibling nx-alert CEF pipeline
split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since the pattern isn't anchored)
tokenize the extension blob (space-lookahead split, tolerant of embedded spaces in request), fixed-slot map fname/fileHash/cs1/cs4/externalId/dvchost, header name/severity, cleanup temp header fields
